scope: Separate Message Center and Duet services

execution.command: cd backend && uv run python checks/message_center_acceptance.py
execution.model: Explicit deterministic offline SDK provider; no live model calls
execution.storage: Disposable isolated PostgreSQL schema and temporary workspaces
execution.external_state: No application database or existing processes modified

cross_service_cases: Alex's Duet publishes a Message Center message addressed to Maya
Immediate delivery produces a private owner report and confirmed owner update
Immediate delivery can complete silently without claiming an owner update or human read
Duplicate delivery callbacks reuse the original request
Maya's explicit attendance response appears in Message Center
Digest delivery waits without an immediate Duet request and is consumed by system review
Accepted delivery survives a Duet worker restart and Message Center outage, then processes after recovery

isolated_regression.command: uv run pytest -q tests/test_message_center.py tests/test_scheduled_tasks.py tests/test_request_concurrency.py tests/test_activity_visibility.py

notification_semantics: notified records a confirmed private owner update. Digest notifications remain conservatively unconfirmed because a general review report cannot be attributed reliably to each receipt. Human read is separate.
